sm_name: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. Chennai Metro Rail Limited redesigned a critical stretch between Alandur and St Thomas Mount to avoid acquiring defence land. The revised alignment involves constructing Phase 2 of Corridor 5 beneath the existing Chennai Central to St Thomas Mount corridor. This change is expected to save six months of construction time. The additional engineering work involves a supplementary tender worth around 300 crore. Chennai Metro Rail Limited plans a 45-day suspension of train services tentatively in February or March 2027, subject to approval from the Commissioner of Railway Safety. The target for completing the entire elevated stretch towards Sholinganallur is September 2027.

attchmntText: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a profit after tax of 59,317.91 lakhs. Revenue from operations stood at 270,260.42 lakhs. The company recognized an exceptional item provision of 11,629.85 lakhs related to a GSTAT order concerning Rail Neer profiteering. The basic earnings per share was 7.41 rupees. The company noted a compliance issue regarding the number of Independent Directors on its Board.
